principle: Views are clustering/lens functions over the same stable module set. A view must not create a separate copy of project data.

views.label: Process / Operations View
views.description: Groups modules by how Grace actually manages work, independent of contract phase as the primary organizing structure.

views.label: Contract Structure View
views.description: Re-clusters the same modules by contractual/deliverable structure, useful because the client-facing UHG dashboard follows contractual LCD/LCW structure.

views.label: PAC → Operations View
views.description: Shows how PAC origin fields populate, validate, or transform into downstream LCW/Pii operational modules.

views.label: Risk / Gap Exposure View
views.description: Clusters modules around missing information, validation-required facts, conflicts, overrides, and quarantine needs.

views.label: Responsibility / Coordination View
views.description: Clusters modules by responsible party or coordination dependency once team/consultant data exists.
